prompt: A new hire waits three days to get a laptop configured with the team’s toolchain. Which GitHub feature exists precisely to remove that wait?
explanation: A codespace is a container-based environment — editor, terminal, tools — that spins up from the repository, so "getting set up" stops being a rite of passage.

options.text: Codespaces — a full cloud development environment ready in seconds
GitHub Pages — a website documenting the setup steps
GitHub Mobile — for configuring laptops remotely
GitHub Sponsors — funding to buy a faster laptop
